question: Who is the writer of this song that was inspired by words on a tombstone and was the first track on the box set Back to Mono?

steps.observation:

[Doc 1] Jeris White:  He was drafted by Miami in the second round of the 1974 NFL Draft.

[Doc 2] Double Dagger:  Their final EP 333 was released in April 2013 alongside a documentary of their final tour, entitled "If We Shout Loud Enough".

[Doc 3] Randall Cunningham:  He played in the NFL for 16 seasons, primarily with the Philadelphia Eagles.

[Doc 4] It's Alive! (Dexter):  In the episode, which takes place five weeks after the first-season finale, Sgt. James Doakes (Erik King) is following Dexter Morgan (Michael C. Hall) at all times, but when he gets his first opportunity Dexter finds himself unable to kill.

[Doc 5] LaRon Landry:  The Washington Redskins drafted him with the sixth overall pick in the 2007 NFL Draft.
